title: Show HN: I've been paying for a rural Tanzanian's education for 10 years
summary: A personal story about the author who, at age 19 while traveling in Tanzania, decided to sponsor the education of a local girl named Anwarite from Ibumila village. This commitment has continued for 10 years, demonstrating how individual actions can create lasting impact on educational access in rural Africa.
problem_solved: Addresses the lack of educational access for children in rural Tanzania where the nearest school is prohibitively expensive for local families.
why_valuable: It demonstrates personal long-term commitment to global education and shows how modest individual contributions (a few hundred dollars per year) can transform a child's life trajectory.
